version_history.note: Restored chart colour tokens to 9 posts. The 2026-08-06 normalisation removed whole <style> blocks carrying the added layers, and in 9 posts those blocks also held the :root custom properties the charts referenced for stroke/fill — so lines rendered with stroke:none and dots fell back to black. Values restored verbatim from the pre-session baseline, CHART tokens only: --ink/--border/--text tokens were deliberately not restored because they were written for a dark surface and would reintroduce light-on-light text.
